question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name as region_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps s ON a.sales_rep_id = s.id
    JOIN web_region r ON s.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name
),
rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name as region_name,
        s.name as sales_rep_name,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as rep_total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps s ON a.sales_rep_id = s.id
    JOIN web_region r ON s.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name, s.name
),
max_per_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        MAX(rep_total_sales) as max_rep_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.region_name,
        rs.sales_rep_name,
        rs.rep_total_sales as sales_amount
    FROM rep_sales rs
    JOIN max_per_region mpr ON rs.region_name = mpr.region_name
    WHERE rs.rep_total_sales = mpr.max_rep_sales
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.order_count,
    rs.total_sales,
    tr.sales_rep_name,
    tr.sales_amount
FROM region_sales rs
JOIN top_reps tr ON rs.region_name = tr.region_name
ORDER BY rs.region_name, rs.order_count
